name: likuloka3d-web
description: Likuloka 3D: a browser building editor on Next.js, React Three Fiber and WebGPU.

scripts.test:cloud: npm run functions:build && firebase emulators:exec --only auth,firestore,functions --project demo-likuloka "node tests/cloud.e2e.cjs"
scripts.test:all: npm test && npm run test:webgl && npm run test:rules && npm run test:cloud
scripts.deploy:hosting: npm run build && firebase deploy --only hosting
scripts.functions:build: npm --prefix functions install --no-audit --no-fund && npm --prefix functions run build
